paite: Jehoshaphat api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmu a, apute lak ah apu David khopi ah avui uhi. Asik in atapa Jehoram alalta hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Jehoram / (2 Kum 8.17-24)
english: Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city; and Jehoram his son reigned in his place.

paite: Ama'n unau, Jehoshaphat tapate anei a, Azariah, Jehiel, Zekariah, Azariahu, Mikael leh Shephatiah ahi uh. Hiai tengteng Israel kumpipa Jehoshaphat tapate vek ahi uhi.
english: He had brothers, the sons of Jehoshaphat: Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariah, Michael, and Shephatiah. All these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.

paite: Apa un thil thupi taktak apia a, dangkasik, dangka-eng, thil mantam pipite, Judah gam a kulh nei khopite toh; himahleh gamte pen Jehoram apia a, ata upapen ahih ziak in.
english: Their father gave them great gifts of silver, of gold, and of precious things, with fortified cities in Judah; but he gave the kingdom to Jehoram, because he was the firstborn.

paite: Huchi in Jehoram in apa gam luah in ahong kihihhatta a, a-unaute tengteng namsau in Israelte lak a intek tampi toh athat vek hi.
english: Now when Jehoram had risen up over the kingdom of his father, and had strengthened himself, he killed all his brothers with the sword, and also some of the princes of Israel.

paite: Jehoram bel kum sawmthum-le-nih a upa ahih in vaihawm apan a: Jerusalem ah kum giat vai ahawm hi.
english: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

paite: Ahab inkote hih bang in Israel kumpipate lampi azui hi: Ahab tanu zi in anei hi. Huchi in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih loutak ahih hi.
english: He walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did Ahab’s house, for he had Ahab’s daughter as his wife. He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight.

paite: Himahleh, TOUPA'N David inkote ahihmang nuam kei; David kiang a thukhun ziak leh amah leh asuante tan a khawnvak neihsak thak ana chiam khit ziak in.
english: However Yahweh would not destroy David’s house, because of the covenant that he had made with David, and as he promised to give a lamp to him and to his children always.

paite: Amah dam lai in Judahte lak a kipan Edomte ahel ua, kumpipa akibawltawm uh.
english: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.

paite: Huchi in Jehoram asepaih heutute leh akangtalai tengteng toh akuankhia a, zan in akuan a, amau leh kangtalai tung a heutute amau umkual Edomte asual hi.
english: Then Jehoram went there with his captains and all his chariots with him. He rose up by night and struck the Edomites who surrounded him, along with the captains of the chariots.

paite: Huchi in Edomte tuni tan in Judahte lak ah ahel lailai uh, huai lai mah in Libnah khote leng ahel uh; TOUPA, apipute uh Pathian alehngatsan ziak in.
english: So Edom has been in revolt from under the hand of Judah to this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time from under his hand, because he had forsaken Yahweh, the God of his fathers.

paite: Huan Judah gam tangte ah mun sang abawl a, Jerusalem mite a-angkawmsak a, Judahte apimang hi.
english: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah, and made the inhabitants of Jerusalem play the prostitute, and led Judah astray.

paite: Huchi in zawlnei Elijah a kipan akiang ah lai ahong tung a, "TOUPA, na pu David Pathian in hichi in achi, 'Na pa Jehoshaphat lampite na tawn kei a, Judahte kumpipa Asa lampite leng na zui kei hi.
english: A letter came to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, “Yahweh, the God of David your father, says, ‘Because you have not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat your father, nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah,

paite: Israel kumpipate lampi na zui zaw a, Judahte leh Jerusalem a omte Ahab inkuan bang in ang na kawmsak a, na unau, na pa inkuante nang sang a hoihzaw na that lai hi.
english: but have walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and have made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to play the prostitute like Ahab’s house did, and also have slain your brothers of your father’s house, who were better than yourself,

paite: Ngai dih, TOUPA'N na mite, na tate, na zite, na gante hipi in agawt ding a;
english: behold, Yahweh will strike your people with a great plague, including your children, your wives, and all your possessions;

paite: gilpi natna thupi mahmah na nei ding a, niteng in natna ziak a na ngoi teng atolhkhiak vek tan in na chi ana ding, " chi in.
english: and you will have great sickness with a disease of your bowels, until your bowels fall out by reason of the sickness, day by day.’”

paite: Huchi in Ethiopia mite kiang a mi Philistiate leh Arabiate lungsim Jehoram sual ding in TOUPA'N atokthou hi.
english: Yahweh stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines and of the Arabians who are beside the Ethiopians;

paite: Huchi in Judate ava sual ua, agam uah alut ua, kumpipa' inn a thil tengteng ala vek ua, atapate, azite uh leng; atapa naupangpen Jehoahaz lousiah atapa dang anutsiat kei uhi.
english: and they came up against Judah, broke into it, and carried away all the possessions that were found in the king’s house, including his sons and his wives, so that there was no son left to him except Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons.

paite: Huai nung in TOUPA'N hihdam thei louh gilnatna in agawt hi.
english: After all this Yahweh struck him in his bowels with an incurable disease.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, akum nihna abei in anatna ziak in angoi apilhkhia a, natna mulkimhuaitak in asita hi. Amite'n apa meipi asehsak bang un asehsak kei uhi.
english: In process of time, at the end of two years, his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness, and he died of severe diseases. His people made no burning for him, like the burning of his fathers.

paite: Avaihawm tung in kum sawmthum-le-nih ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum giat vai ahawm a, kuamah it louh in asi a, David khopi ah kumpipate han lou ah avui uhi.
english: He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years. He departed with no one’s regret. They buried him in David’s city, but not in the tombs of the kings.
